latitude.description: Optional legacy field — not required (location already validated at check-in)

present.description: true = partner marked arrived / on site; false = marked left

at.description: Device ISO-8601 timestamp for the presence change

status.description: Visit outcome (defaults to COMPLETED). Cancel/call-off are not allowed on the carer app.

publicPort.description: Public TCP port of the browser connection when known (1–65535)
